slices.acceptance: No requirement ID equality inference; preserve AND/OR/context/levels/verification state; missing mapping fail closed

slices.scope: Approved evidence/outcome claims project to existing CourseCapabilityProfile shape, pins in sidecars

slices.acceptance: No silent backfill, prefix rewrite or DRAFT activation; replay preserved; future gated fixtures separate
